A.name: Stack A: AppSec, Container CVE & Certificate Watchdog
A.tagline: OWASP ZAP audits authorized web/API surfaces, Trivy scans containers & SBOMs for CVEs, SonarQube runs SAST code security, Uptime Kuma monitors TLS certs & uptime 24/7.

B.name: Stack B: Defensive IPS, Zero-Knowledge Vault, DFIR & SOAR
B.tagline: CrowdSec blocks brute-force & bot attacks in real time, Vaultwarden secures team credentials, CyberChef accelerates SOC IOC triage, n8n SOAR automates incident alerts.

owasp-zap.name: OWASP ZAP DAST
owasp-zap.role: Authorized web & API vulnerability scanner with headless REST API & WebSwing UI
owasp-zap.first_run: Open /zap for the interactive OWASP ZAP WebSwing console to run authorized baseline scans.

trivy-server.name: Aqua Trivy CVE Server
trivy-server.role: Fast container image, filesystem, IaC & SBOM vulnerability scanning server
trivy-server.first_run: Run `trivy image --server http://localhost:7510 <image>` in CI/CD or from n8n SOAR.

sonarqube-sast.name: SonarQube SAST
sonarqube-sast.role: Static Application Security Testing (SAST), OWASP Top 10 & secret leak code analyzer
sonarqube-sast.first_run: Default local login: admin / admin (prompts to update on first sign-in). Connect GitHub repos for SAST.

uptime-kuma-sec.name: Uptime Kuma TLS Watch
uptime-kuma-sec.role: 24/7 SSL/TLS certificate expiry, DNS, port & HTTP security availability monitor
uptime-kuma-sec.first_run: Create your local admin login and add TLS expiry alerts (14d / 7d) + n8n webhook notifications.

crowdsec-ips.name: CrowdSec IPS & LAPI
crowdsec-ips.role: Collaborative open-source intrusion prevention system blocking brute-force & bad IPs
crowdsec-ips.first_run: Exposes CrowdSec Local API (LAPI) on :7600 for Nginx/Firewall bouncers and n8n threat alerts.

vaultwarden-sec.name: Vaultwarden Zero-Trust
vaultwarden-sec.role: Self-hosted Bitwarden-compatible encrypted vault for SSH keys, API tokens & 2FA
vaultwarden-sec.first_run: Create your team vault account and eliminate plaintext credentials across repos and servers.

cyberchef-soc.name: GCHQ CyberChef SOC
cyberchef-soc.role: Offline DFIR & SOC workbench for decoding payloads, JWTs, headers & IOC hashes
cyberchef-soc.first_run: 100% browser-local DFIR analysis — inspect suspicious logs, certificates, and IOCs safely offline.

n8n-soar.name: n8n SOAR Playbooks
n8n-soar.role: Automated security orchestration wiring Trivy CVEs, CrowdSec blocks & SOC alerts
n8n-soar.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_cve_triage_soar.n8n.json to automate CVE severity triage & alerts.
